svg.title: Samsung & Apple TV Remote
svg.desc: The remote window, the command line and the ESP32 bridge all get their TV client from make_client, which hands back the Samsung client or the Apple TV client; both offer the same methods, so every entry point works with either TV. The Samsung client talks to the TV over WebSocket, REST and DLNA and wakes it with Wake-on-LAN; the Apple TV client goes through pyatv. To cast, the window or command line starts a small file server on the PC, and the TV fetches the file from it. An ESP32 touch screen drives the bridge over HTTP. a key from the window: Remote window → make_client → Samsung client → Samsung TV. a tap on the ESP32: ESP32 touch screen → ESP32 bridge → make_client → Apple TV client → Apple TV. casting a video: Remote window → Cast server → Samsung TV, Apple TV.
